title: Marketing Analytics and Customer Data Platform Implementation
raw_description: BC Lottery Corporation (BCLC) seeks a vendor to implement a Customer Data Platform (CDP) and marketing analytics capability. Deliverables: (1) CDP implementation (Segment or mParticle) integrating online gaming, retail lottery, and PlayNow digital channels, (2) marketing attribution modelling in Snowflake, (3) audience segmentation for CRM campaigns, (4) real-time Power BI dashboards for marketing performance, (5) A/B testing framework. The vendor must have demonstrated CDP implementation experience, Snowflake expertise, and understanding of responsible gambling regulatory requirements. Python or R-based statistical modelling experience required.

ground_truth.rationale: Good match on Snowflake, Power BI, Python/R statistical modelling. BCLC is a Crown corporation — ideal Your Organization client profile. CDP is adjacent to Your Organization capabilities. Regulatory context manageable.
